title: EvidenceSpan Traceability Contract
description: Standard schema for immutable character-level evidence spans linking factual assertions to authoritative news source texts.

span_id.description: Unique immutable identifier for this character-level evidence span.

source_doc_id.description: Document identifier in upstream CMS authority corresponding to source news event.

source_url.description: Canonical public or archive URL of the original source article.

paragraph_index.description: 0-based paragraph index within the source document.

char_start.description: 0-based inclusive character start offset within the referenced paragraph.

char_end.description: 0-based exclusive character end offset within the referenced paragraph.

quoted_text.description: Exact verbatim excerpt extracted from source document.

span_hash.description: SHA-256 cryptographic digest of quoted_text (UTF-8 encoded), preventing retroactive tampering.

quality_state.description: Current integrity and verification status of the evidence span.
